Redragon Kumara K552 E RGB Red Switch Mechanical Gaming Keyboard – Specifications

General

  • Type: Mechanical Gaming Keyboard

  • Model: K552 Kumara RGB

  • Layout: Tenkeyless (TKL) – 87 Keys

  • Connectivity: Wired USB

  • Cable Length: 1.8 m 

Switches

  • Switch Type: Outemu Red Mechanical Switches (Linear)

  • Keystroke Lifespan: Up to 50 Million Clicks

  • Actuation Force: ≈50 g 

Lighting

  • RGB Rainbow Backlighting

  • Up to 19 lighting effects

  • Adjustable brightness & breathing speed 

Keyboard Features

  • 100% Anti-Ghosting (N-Key Rollover)

  • 12 Multimedia Keys

  • Double-shot injection keycaps

  • Win-key lock for gaming 

Build & Design

  • Metal + ABS construction

  • Plate-mounted mechanical switches

  • Splash-resistant design

  • Non-slip feet with adjustable angle 

Size & Weight

  • Dimensions: 354 × 123 × 37 mm

  • Weight: ≈0.87 kg 

Compatibility

  • Windows 10 / 8 / 7 / Vista / XP

  • Limited support for Mac OS 

✅ Key Features

  • Compact 87-key TKL gaming keyboard

  • Red linear switches for smooth typing & gaming

  • RGB lighting effects with multiple modes

  • Durable metal top plate design
